method: model runs on uploaded images via shipped endpoint (threads); SVG rasterized; AI image model told to reproduce the render EXACTLY (change-NOTHING prompt); CONTROL: same AI+prompt on the ORIGINAL input raster. Only the gap between render-arbiter and control-arbiter is attributable to the SVG — an image generator restyles ANY image it is fed, control-included.

teal-logo.verdict: UNDERSTOOD (n=2): sample 1 inverted the hollow center (ssim 0.199 vs render) but sample 2 from the same render reproduced the interior correctly (ssim 0.9224, f_mae 0.9958) — generator variance, not lost semantics. Control (same AI on the original) scored ssim 0.9263 on one draw; the render is as legible to an independent vision model as the original.

blue-bird.verdict: UNDERSTOOD: AI-from-output and AI-from-input are nearly identical (arbiter ssim 0.4694/f_mae 0.9898 vs control 0.5445/0.9856; mae BETTER via the render: 2.59 vs 3.67). The vector output reads as clearly as the original.

overall: Both uploaded images: the shipped model output is semantically legible to an independent AI image model under a change-NOTHING prompt — the bird output was reproduced as faithfully as its original; the teal output was reproduced correctly on the second draw (variance, not incomprehension). Combined with strict pixel fidelity (teal 87.9/min-channel, bird 74.5) and byte-identical reproduction of the committed evidence SVGs, outputs are good; residual bird gap is the documented glow-gradient wall (training loop).
